consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for TK-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically managing freeboard, beach and decant. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during shift handover while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 3 December 2018 a planned critical control verification of TK-7104 and PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the control of freeboard, beach width and decant not effective.
